'''Star Tours Flight 619''' was the designation of a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency flight that traveled to [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] and [[Nubia/Legends|Nubia]]. At the time of the [[Raid at Spaceport THX1138]], the flight had just landed at Gate 1F in time for its scheduled arrival at 0725 hours. It was then scheduled to depart at 0820.
